name: When should I hire a general contractor instead of managing trades myself?
description: Hire a general contractor whenever a project requires building permits, structural work, or multiple trade specialists like electricians, plumbers, and framers.

mainEntity.name: When should I hire a general contractor instead of managing trades myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: You generally need a general contractor when your project involves structural changes, foundation alterations, multiple licensed trades, or mandatory building permits. Projects like ground-up homes, large room additions, or major layout reconfigurations require synchronized scheduling among framing, electrical, plumbing, and mechanical crews. If a project requires city or county inspections and engineering plans, managing it through a licensed general contractor prevents costly code failures, safety hazards, and project delays.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hire a general contractor whenever a project requires building permits, structural work, or multiple trade specialists like electricians, plumbers, and framers.
